title: AWF Diagnosis Finding
description: A single machine-readable AWF diagnosis finding. Records live in docs/diagnostics/findings/<boundary>/<ID>.json and are the canonical diagnosis knowledge state. See docs/diagnostics/patterns.md for the update protocol.

$schema.description: Relative or absolute JSON Schema reference for editor validation.

id.description: Stable finding ID. Runner findings retain the historical A/B/C/D catalog IDs (for example 'A1'); other boundaries use a namespace prefix (RT-, NET-, AUTH-, CI-, SEC-). IDs are never recycled.

title.description: Short human-readable summary of the failure.

symptoms.description: Concise symptom signatures (observable error strings or behaviours) used for matching.

conditions.description: Discriminating conditions that must hold for this finding to match. Used to disambiguate overlapping symptoms.

affects.description: Topology dimensions this finding applies to. Use 'unknown' when unverified and 'any' when the dimension is irrelevant.

versions.description: AWF version or commit scope. Use 'unknown' when the scope has not been verified against the default branch; never assert a shipped fix from an open PR or provider documentation alone.

supersededBy.description: ID of the finding that replaces this one. Required when status is 'superseded'.

rootCause.description: Root cause, distinct from the symptom.

probe.description: Smallest discriminating probe. Must be read-only and secret-safe: no credential values, token exchanges, inference calls, or environment dumps.

action.description: Recommended fix or workaround. Never recommends disabling isolation, broadening an allowlist by default, or dumping credentials.

references.description: Provenance: issues/merged PRs plus implementation or test citations.

ref.description: An https URL, or a repository-relative path (optionally with a #anchor) for doc/code/test references.

related.description: Cross-links to other finding IDs instead of duplicating a cause across boundaries.

owner.description: Owning team or handle responsible for review.

reviewBy.description: Next review date (YYYY-MM-DD) for the maintenance cadence.
